snippet.title: Coins in Place | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Coins in Place is in development by Alunova Studios and Zignus.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5254210/Coins_in_Place/

Coins in Place is an incremental game where you work as a coin picker in a messy tavern. 

Pick up every coin before the day ends! Earn gems, buy upgrades, and recruit cats to help you. 

On Day 7, a mountain of coins awaits. Miss even one and you're stuck working another week.
